observations.friction: The OMP LSP rule interrupted a Prettier check for unrelated plan-rule files even though its policy excludes unrelated repository toolchain work.
observations.workaround: Use the background formatter result and continue without applying the unrelated LSP guidance.

pc-127bb3af1002afa4.summary: Narrow the OMP LSP rule activation so unrelated formatter commands do not interrupt.

observations.friction: The helper requires the target path to exist before git add, so deleted allow-listed files fail with path does not exist.
observations.workaround: Stage the exact deleted allow-listed path with git add -- path, matching the helper's add invocation.

pc-1bbd03aa0a592ee3.summary: Deleted manifest-allowed paths cannot be staged through the helper.

observations.friction: Each valid case duplicates the rendered report in both prompt and expected_output; a format change can update one copy while leaving the other stale.
observations.workaround: Parse each input fence and rewrite both report copies from the same changed array, then assert they match.

pc-4a26350015d31957.summary: Keep embedded prompt goldens and expected outputs synchronized.

observations.friction: When existing baseline cases were revised, keep-check rejected eight of them even though they were already classified in ADDED_IDS, because baseline keep exclusion consults REWRITE_IDS separately. Maintainers must know when one case ID belongs in both sets.
observations.workaround: Run the pinned keep-check after every registry edit and duplicate each changed baseline-present ID into REWRITE_IDS.

pc-a556fa1f9529ba9a.summary: Make changed-case classification follow the pinned baseline without overlapping manual ID sets.

observations.friction: Repeated assurance-tail refinements still leave a risk of narrowly scoped proof or duplicated reviewer opinions, which can make repair and rerun work lower-value than intended.
observations.workaround: Manually inspect repository verification guidance, freeze criterion-specific proof recipes, and consolidate direct-evidence findings under the existing bounded repair and one-review contracts.

pc-ae711c27c4d758b7.summary: Make repository-specific proof mechanics and bounded evidence partitioning explicit before assurance runs.

observations.friction: plan.md forbids ## Execution gate on new or revised executable plans, but executor_plan.py --consumer planner reports status=valid when that section is present
observations.workaround: after planner validation, inspect headings for ## Execution gate and reject or remove it before publication

pc-e1c8b1660bfd1b81.summary: planner validator accepts obsolete Execution gate
